json.summary: A grumpy man confronts a truck, claiming the vehicle hit him last Tuesday, broke both his legs, and that he has been lying on the flatbed ever since (despite clearly standing on the ground in every panel). The truck driver argues he wasn't there, but after the man explains he was hit by 'two big bags' and curses his life, the driver resignedly offers him a blanket because it's getting cold. The humor relies on heavy Hungarian swearing, absurd logic, deliberate misspellings on the truck's signage, and the visual contradiction of the man claiming to be bedridden while standing.

characters.name: Grumpy Man
characters.description: A rough-looking man with a vest, backpack, and messy hair. He speaks in heavy slang and swears frequently ('MI A FASZOM', 'AKURVA'). He absurdly claims to be a woman named 'Gubacs Teréz' and insists he is lying on the truck's flatbed despite standing next to it.

characters.name: Truck Driver
characters.description: The voice of the truck (anthropomorphized). Speaks aggressively with slang ('BAZME', 'MI A GECIT') but eventually shows a weird kind of care by offering a blanket. Makes grunting noises ('HRAHGHHRRR').

panels.description: The Grumpy Man walks past a truck with a broom sticking out. The truck has a misspelled sign 'ÉPÖIPAI KITTELEZÉS' (Construction Execution). Text 'HLOTT!' and 'RITY!' appears, likely nonsense or severe misspellings.
The truck makes a grunting sound. The Grumpy Man stops and exclaims 'MI A FASZOM?' (What the f***?). The side of the truck shows a sign '7722.683/FELVESZEM' (I pick up/answer).

The Truck Driver asks who is on his flatbed. The Grumpy Man claims to be 'Gubacs Teréz', says the truck hit him, broke his legs, and that he is 'lying here' (text in a box), creating a visual gag as he is standing.
The Truck Driver denies being there today. The Grumpy Man clarifies it happened 'last Tuesday'. The sign '7722.683/FELVESZEM' is visible again.
The Truck Driver questions how the man survived since last Tuesday. The Man explains he was coming out of a shop and got hit by 'two big bags'. The sign is visible.
The Grumpy Man curses 'AKURVA ÉLET!' (A f***ing life!). He is walking away or gesturing. The sign '7722.683/FELVESZEM' is on the truck.
The truck makes another grunting sound 'AAAARRRGH....'. The sign is visible.
The Truck Driver offers a blanket ('ITT EGY PLÉD'), saying it gets cold at night. The Grumpy Man gestures towards the truck. The sign is visible.

notes: Swearing: 'MI A FASZOM' (What my d***? = What the f***?), 'MI A GECIT' (What the p***? = What the f***?), 'BAZME' (F*** your mother = very common Hungarian slang, aggressive but also filler like 'mate'), 'AKURVA' (A f***ing [life]). Tone is very rough and colloquial.

Misspellings: The sign 'ÉPÖIPAI KITTELEZÉS' is a deliberate misspelling of 'ÉPÍTŐIPARI KIVITELEZÉS' (Construction Execution), suggesting a shady business. 'HLOTT!' and 'RITY!' in p0 are likely nonsense or corrupted text.
Name Gag: 'GUBACS TERÉZ'. 'Gubacs' means gall/burr, 'Teréz' is a female name. The speaker is a rough man, adding to the absurdity.
Visual Gag: In p2, the text 'FEKSZEM ITT' (I am lying here) implies the man is on the flatbed, but he is drawn standing next to the truck. This contradiction persists.
Running Sign: '7722.683/FELVESZEM' appears on the truck side in almost every panel. 'Felveszem' means 'I pick up' (hitchhikers/loads) or 'I answer' (phone). It acts as a repetitive background detail.
Punchline: The truck driver accepts the absurd situation and offers a blanket in p7, showing a weird shift from aggression to care.
